description: Starfighter in the İzelman park at İnciraltı, Balçova, wearing the code 4-316. Construction number 683D-6015. The International F-104 Society records that the tail fitted to this airframe came from CF-104 104733, so the aircraft is a composite.
museum_name: İzelman Parkı F-104 Monument -- Balçova, İzmir
